title: fix(spec): try_catch nodeId and errorVariable describes say what the engine binds
body:
Closes #24659

## What

Two `.describe()` sentences in `packages/spec/src/automation/control-flow.zod.ts` now say what the engine actually binds. No schema shape, default or runtime path changes.

- `TryCatchErrorValue.nodeId`: was "Node the failure is attributed to". The engine (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/try-catch-node.ts`, the `errorValue` literal) binds `nodeId: node.id`, the Try / Catch node's own id; the failing inner step only appears inside `message`. New text: "Id of this Try / Catch node, not of the step that failed inside its try region; that step is normally named inside `message`".
- `TryCatchConfig.errorVariable`: drops "The value is a `TryCatchErrorValue`: ..." and says in words what the value carries, aligned with the node descriptor text that PR #24655 landed ("the id of this Try / Catch node (`nodeId`), the failure message, which normally names the step that failed (`message`) ..."). The ADR-0112 `$error.code` branching hint is kept.

Regenerated with repo tooling (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`): `content/docs/references/automation/control-flow.mdx` (the two table rows). The shipped `json-schema/automation/TryCatchConfig.json` and `TryCatchErrorValue.json` are gitignored build output and carry the new text after the build (grep count 1 each, measured on the built tree). No test pinned either sentence (`git grep` of both old sentences outside the generated page: zero hits besides the source).

Changeset: `.changeset/24659-try-catch-describes.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch.
